diffs.diff: pressure_Pa: datasheet reading gives 0.0000019073486328125 per count, the part's model has -0.0004978, -0.00189, 1000, 1000
diffs.evidence: 0.0000019073486328125 = 1/524288, the Table 4 scale factor kP for single oversampling ('1 (single) 524288'). Sec. 5.6.1 uses it only to form the dimensionless 'Praw_sc = Praw/kP'; pressure in Pa is 'Pcomp(Pa) = c00+ Praw_sc*(c10 + Praw_sc*(c20+ Praw_sc*c30)) + Traw_sc*c01 + Traw_sc*Praw_sc*(c11+Praw_sc*c21)', i.e. it depends on per-chip coefficients, so 1/524288 is not Pa per count. The model's sim stores coefficients c00 = 0x14050 = 82000 Pa, c10 = 0xF4480 = -48000 (20-bit two's complement), others 0, and the driver uses 16x pressure oversampling (kP = 253952, Table 4), so P = 82000 - 48000*Praw/253952 Pa = 820 - 0.00189012*Praw hPa, matching the model's -0.00189 scale / 820 offset (control unit hPa). The 1000-scale entries emulate MEAS_CFG (0x08) ready bits, not a conversion. Driver implements sec. 5.6.1 exactly; check.ts simulator test passes (T=23.70C P=987.60hPa).

diffs.diff: temperature_C: datasheet reading gives 0.0000019073486328125 per count, the part's model has -0.0004978, -0.00189, 1000, 1000
diffs.evidence: 0.0000019073486328125 = 1/524288 is kT for single oversampling (Table 4), used for 'Traw_sc = Traw/kT'; the datasheet temperature is 'Tcomp (°C) = c0*0.5 + c1*Traw_sc' (sec. 5.6.2), so °C per count is c1/kT, not 1/kT. The model's sim coefficients give c0 = 0x0CC = 204 (c0*0.5 = 102 °C offset) and c1 = 0xEFB = -261 (12-bit two's complement); with the driver's default single temperature oversampling (kT = 524288): T = 102 - 261*Traw/524288 = 102 - 0.00049782*Traw °C, exactly the model's scale -0.0004978179931640625 and offset 102. The 1000-scale entries are MEAS_CFG status-bit emulation. check.ts simulator test passes.
